rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality blastocyst with identifiable ICM and cohesive TE, notes visible zona and possible lesser expansion/collapse, and appropriately defers to lab grading; minor staging confusion limits a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, PCOS, smoking, ovarian response, semen parameters, BMI, endometrium, and first-cycle status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and conclusions generally follow from morphology and clinical factors; small issues include overemphasis on image-vs-grade discrepancy and a questionable ectopic follow-up comment tied to PCOS.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, caution about morphology limits, smoking cessation, and selective PGT-A discussion; minor deviations include some imprecise Gardner staging commentary and speculative adjunct considerations.

Provides practical next steps for transfer optimization and future-cycle review, including lifestyle changes and when to consider PGT-A or uterine/metabolic reassessment; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
